criteria.statement: Soul Factory loads, validates, normalizes, and deduplicates optional concord_communities entries, each with exactly one non-inline invite bundle secret source.
Invite bundles are size-bounded, structurally validated, self-certified by recomputing community_id from owner and owner_salt, and reject malformed, expired, over-broad, or mismatched material.
Each assignment emits a CORD-05 kind-3313 rumor with empty tags inside a staff-signed kind-13 seal and ephemeral kind-1059 wrap carrying exact p recipient and k=3313 tags.
Rumor encryption and seal signing use the Signet-held staff identity; the outer wrap uses a single-use ephemeral key and all published events are signature-valid.

Concord onboarding runs after agent Signet provisioning, requires relay authentication and accepted OK, fails closed on any error, and records successful community identifiers without secret material.

Soul Factory operator and user documentation describes optional Concord onboarding, secret references, relay delivery, failure semantics, and the CORD-06 rotation requirement after mistaken disclosure.
